abstract: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (misinformation) when agents are biased and able to verify messages. As a recipient of a false message who verifies it becomes informed of the truth, a higher prevalence of misinformation can increase the prevalence of the truth. We uncover conditions such that this happens and discuss policy implications. Specifically, a planner aiming to maximize the prevalence of the truth should allow misinformation to circulate if: non-verified messages may be ignored, transmission of information is relatively low, and the planner's budget to induce verification is neither too low nor too high. Homophily increases the spread of misinformation, but also facilitates diffusion of truth, and leads to similar results on the effect of verification.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当个体存在偏见且能够验证信息时，真实信息与虚假信息（错误信息）的传播机制。当接收虚假信息的个体通过验证获知真相时，错误信息的更高流行度反而可能提升真相的普及程度。我们揭示了此类现象发生的条件，并探讨其政策启示。具体而言，若规划者旨在最大化真相普及度，则应在以下情形允许错误信息传播：未经验证的信息可能被忽略、信息传播效率相对较低、且规划者用于诱导验证的预算既不过低也不过高。同质性虽会加剧错误信息的扩散，但同时也促进真相的传播，并对验证效果产生类似影响。
title: Optimal Verification of (Mis)Information in Networks
title_zh: 网络中（错误）信息的最优验证

abstract: We quantify the role of heterogeneity in households' financial constraints in explaining the link between the decline in aggregate consumption and the decline in house values between 2006 and 2009 using individual‐level data. Constraints that are triggered by a decline in house values, and a small fraction of consumers facing particularly severe constraints prior to the decline in house values explain 76% of the aggregate response. Local general equilibrium feedback and a decline in bank credit to consumers make up the remaining 24%. We find no contribution of a pure wealth effect in explaining the consumption decline.
abstract_zh: 我们利用个体层面数据，量化了家庭金融约束异质性在解释2006年至2009年间总消费下降与房屋价值下降之间关联中的作用。由房屋价值下降触发的约束，以及在房屋价值下降前已面临特别严重约束的一小部分消费者，解释了总消费反应的76%。局部一般均衡反馈和银行对消费者信贷的下降构成了剩余的24%。我们发现，纯财富效应在解释消费下降中并无贡献。
title: Housing Wealth and Consumption: The Role of Heterogeneous Credit Constraints
title_zh: 住房财富与消费：异质性信贷约束的作用

abstract: Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。研究表明，在市场不完备且存在信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即便政府不掌握额外信息，其干预也可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利效应高度依赖于经济体的具体特征及政策设计。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等常见政策目标，可能对福利产生截然不同的影响。
title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预

abstract: Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。
title: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
title_zh: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇

abstract: We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。
title: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
title_zh: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响

abstract: We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。
title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿

abstract: We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制

abstract: While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.
abstract_zh: 现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。
title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

abstract: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在价格设定决策中因信号提取问题而扭曲的经济环境下的最优货币政策：企业无法基于含噪的局部信息完美区分总体冲击与异质性冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性误归因于企业特定因素的现象，会引发额外的价格反应，意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最优选择。相反，最优政策应完全稳定产出缺口，这必然要求容忍价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从局部需求信号中学习会导致价格水平呈顺周期性，而从局部生产率信号中学习则会产生逆周期性。
title: Optimal monetary policy with confounding information
title_zh: 混淆信息下的最优货币政策

title: When Can Less Be More? Inducing Dealer Responses in RFQ Platforms
title_zh: 何时少即是多？在RFQ平台中诱导交易商反应

title: On Preference for Simplicity and Probability Weighting
title_zh: 关于简单偏好与概率加权

journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: The uncertainty premium of climate tipping points
title_zh: 气候临界点的不确定性溢价

abstract: Focus We examine how geopolitical risks affect sovereign risk premia for emerging market economies (EMEs). We focus on two measures of sovereign risk: five-year sovereign credit default swap (SCDS) spreads, which show the cost of insuring against a country's default, and JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index (EMBI) spreads, which reflect the extra return investors demand for holding emerging market bonds.
abstract_zh: 焦点 本文考察地缘政治风险如何影响新兴市场经济体的主权风险溢价。我们聚焦于两种主权风险指标：五年期主权信用违约互换（SCDS）利差（反映针对一国违约的保险成本）以及摩根大通新兴市场债券指数（EMBI）利差（体现投资者持有新兴市场债券所要求的额外回报）。
title: Geopolitical risk and emerging market sovereign risk premia
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与新兴市场主权风险溢价

abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。
title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
title_zh: 自然灾害期间的财政乘数

abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。
title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率

abstract: This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。
title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响

abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。
title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果

title: Parameter-invariant unbiased estimation of individual variances and their pairwise products
title_zh: 个体方差及其两两乘积的参数不变无偏估计

abstract: European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.
abstract_zh: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并制定了旨在延续这些家庭的政策。多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及对大家庭的补贴和税收减免。本文以纳粹德国为案例，采用双重差分法研究发现，由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生适得其反的效果。对单身者施加的过度婚姻压力导致婚姻质量下降，最终形成生育率更低、关系更脆弱的结合。这一发现具有重要意义，因为当今欧洲主要极右翼政党正提议重新推行此类政策组合。
title: Pronatalist Policies’ Backlash in Authoritarian Regimes
title_zh: 威权体制下生育鼓励政策的反噬效应

abstract: Europe pays for innovative medicines through 27 uncoordinated national negotiations, generating access delays, cross-country pricing externalities, and a weak position vis-à-vis both pharmaceutical firms and US trade and most-favoured nation pressure. This column argues that Europe should procure innovative on-patent medicines through a single European negotiation that fixes one wholesale price for the entire Single Market, while reintroducing equity across member states through differentiated national contributions and side transfers. Decoupling what the innovator receives from what each country pays would end the pathologies of external reference pricing and parallel trade, restore Europe's bargaining power, and guarantee simultaneous access for all European patients.
abstract_zh: 欧洲通过27个缺乏协调的国家谈判为创新药物买单，导致患者获取药物延迟、跨境定价外部性，以及面对制药公司、美国贸易与最惠国待遇压力时处于弱势地位。本文认为，欧洲应通过单一欧洲谈判采购创新专利药物，为整个单一市场设定统一的批发价格，同时通过差异化的国家缴费和横向转移支付重新实现成员国间的公平。将创新者获得的报酬与各国实际支付金额脱钩，将终结外部参考定价和平行贸易的弊端，恢复欧洲的议价能力，并确保所有欧洲患者能够同步获得药物。
title: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
title_zh: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购

abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。
title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱

abstract: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
abstract_zh: 本文研究承诺能力如何影响对抗性谈判中的威胁。在此类情境中，提议方（检察官）向回应方（被告）提出要求，并以要求遭拒后发生冲突作为威胁。本文聚焦辩诉交易：检察官在谈判前先对被告提出指控；若双方未达成协议，案件进入审判，指控将影响双方收益。检察官在审判中的预期收益在较低指控水平达到最大，而使被告损失最大化的指控水平更高。审判开始前，检察官可依据其承诺能力，在一定范围内降低指控。实验数据显示，具备足够承诺能力的参与者会通过提出过高指控来增强谈判能力，但其行为比理论预测更为保守。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Commitment and threats in adversarial bargaining: Insights from a plea bargaining experiment
title_zh: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示

abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
abstract_zh: 共和党人比民主党人创办了更多企业。在2005年至2017年间4000万有党派归属的美国人的样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为企业家。这种党派创业差距具有时变性——共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，在我们的13年样本期内，这相当于17万家新企业的党派间重新配置。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统当选前后，党派创业行为发生了急剧变化，其中对政治参与度最高的党派成员（即捐款和投票者）影响最为显著。
title: Partisan Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 党派创业

abstract: We infer risk‐free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in 10 G11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between United States and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option‐implied rates are a similar size between the United States and each other country. A model in which convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations reflect the funding costs of international arbitrageurs financed with dollar‐denominated debt, explains these results.
abstract_zh: 我们从指数期权价格中推断无风险利率，以估算10种G11货币的安全资产便利收益率。各国的便利收益率随其利率水平上升而增加，其中美国的便利收益率位列第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率上升，但美国与外国便利收益率之间的差异通常并未扩大。使用我们基于期权隐含利率计算的抛补利率平价（CIP）偏差，在美国与其他国家之间规模相近。一个模型解释了这些结果：便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，而CIP偏差则反映了以美元计价债务融资的国际套利者的融资成本。
title: Risk‐Free Rates and Convenience Yields around the World
title_zh: 全球无风险利率与便利收益
